concept: Dataflow streaming MongoDB CDC userOption representations
summary: Source-anchored research for Dataflow streaming MongoDB CDC userOption representations. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: NONE is the documented default. In the pinned helper it serializes the input document with GSON.toJson and stores that JSON-formatted text in the STRING source_data field; this is a representation statement, not a guarantee of lossless original BSON types. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/dataflow/docs/guides/templates/provided/mongodb-change-stream-to-bigquery ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/DataflowTemplates/e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53/v2/mongodb-to-googlecloud/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/teleport/v2/mongodb/templates/MongoDbUtils.java

For the streaming template, JSON selects the BigQuery JSON representation rather than the JSON-encoded STRING representation selected by NONE. The pinned helper sets the source_data schema type to JSON for JSON and STRING otherwise; its JSON row path supplies a Map rather than the NONE path’s JSON-encoded string. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/dataflow/docs/guides/templates/provided/mongodb-change-stream-to-bigquery ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/DataflowTemplates/e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53/v2/mongodb-to-googlecloud/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/teleport/v2/mongodb/templates/MongoDbUtils.java ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/DataflowTemplates/e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53/v2/mongodb-to-googlecloud/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/teleport/v2/mongodb/templates/MongoDbCdcToBigQuery.java

Google labels FLATTEN as single-level output. At commit e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53, the helper called by the streaming pipeline iterates top-level document entries, skips nulls, preserves Double/Integer/Long/Boolean values, serializes nested org.bson.Document values with Gson, and uses toString for other classes. That code path does not establish arbitrary recursive path flattening or lossless BSON type preservation. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/dataflow/docs/guides/templates/provided/mongodb-change-stream-to-bigquery ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/DataflowTemplates/e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53/v2/mongodb-to-googlecloud/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/teleport/v2/mongodb/templates/MongoDbUtils.java ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/DataflowTemplates/e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53/v2/mongodb-to-googlecloud/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/teleport/v2/mongodb/templates/MongoDbCdcToBigQuery.java

Estuary and Evonence explicitly identify their demonstrated Dataflow walkthroughs as batch-template examples. Their walkthroughs therefore do not independently verify the streaming template representation schema. (medium confidence) Sources: https://estuary.dev/blog/mongodb-to-bigquery-methods/ ; https://www.evonence.com/blog/mongodb-to-bigquery-data-ingestion-amp-post-processing-using-dataflow-amp-eventarc
The streaming template lists FLATTEN, JSON and NONE as the userOption values. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26)

At commit e4b19022e6f66bebb02211b667909bd55abfbe53, MongoDbCdcToBigQuery.run passes userOption to its schema builder and to MongoDbUtils.getTableSchema after its UDF transform step. This establishes that the shared helper participates in the CDC streaming representation path; it is source-code wiring, not a claim about a deployed template build. (medium confidence)

The pinned MongoDbUtilsTest invokes getTableSchema for FLATTEN, JSON and NONE. It asserts non-null results and timestamp for FLATTEN, and id/source_data/timestamp keys for JSON and NONE. These are visible source-test assertions; this research did not execute the tests or establish coverage of every nested/BSON case. (low confidence)
